title: Build Your AI Setup for Physicians: A Guided Configuration Prompt for Large Language Model Use in Dermatology
description: Guided configuration document referenced in Ranpariya, Feldman, and Zirwas (JEADV). Part 1 generates standing preferences for a large language model; Part 2 builds a physician-facing clinical consultant. For physician use only. Do not enter protected health information.
